label: For "Public Service Case Routing and Priority": Route incoming cases to the right team and flag those at risk of missing a legal deadline, so staff time goes to the urgent and complex. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Model-set legal deadlines.
